description: This file defines the GroupRole entity class representing roles assigned to clients within a group in the Fineract system.

classes.name: GroupRole
classes.description: Entity representing the role of a client within a group, including methods for creating and updating roles.

methods.name: createGroupRole
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new GroupRole with specified group, client, and role.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the GroupRole entity based on changes in the provided JsonCommand object, returning a map of actual changes.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Sets a new CodeValue as the role of the GroupRole.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Associates a new Client with the GroupRole.
